description: Defines data structures and enums related to UE context management in F1AP, including setup, modification, and failure parameters for SRB and DRB, as well as associated QoS and transport layer info.

classes.name: f1ap_srb_to_setup
classes.description: Parameters for setting up a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) in the UE context.

classes.name: f1ap_srb_failed_to_setup
classes.description: Parameters indicating failure to set up an SRB, including cause.

classes.name: flow_mapped_to_drb
classes.description: Associates a QoS flow ID with QoS parameters for mapping to a DRB.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_info
classes.description: Contains QoS, NSSAI, and notification control info for a DRB.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_to_setup
classes.description: Parameters for setting up a new DRB, including transport info and QoS.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_to_modify
classes.description: Parameters for modifying an existing DRB's transport info.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_setupmod
classes.description: Parameters for setup or modification of a DRB, including RLC reestablishment status.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_failed_to_setupmod
classes.description: Indicates failure in setting up or modifying a DRB, with cause.
